changes: Ported from JavaScript to C# on 2026-11-06, with the same stats, shops, prices, dialogue, voices and town melee behavior. Mood lines use the game's {BiomeName} and {NPCName} placeholders instead of {0}. The love for the other resident is set in SetStaticDefaults instead of a PostSetupContent step. The Fly's removal sound plays when the buff icon is tapped, just before the removal instead of just after.
